INFO: button_label is the text of the button in every card. On live Wix the photo, the title and the Book Now button of a card all link to a Wix Bookings page for that service. ASK: none. The earlier question was what the photo foils-highlights (Highlights & Lowlights card) shows. Version 1, first version of this site: Stylist finishing a blowout with hairspray (Gallery page) and Stylist finishing a blowout in the salon (Home page). Version 2, live Wix About page, alt text on the same Wix media file (37eb08_e3724fb50274487ab7afa56767278d97~mv2.jpg): Applying blonde highlights with foils to a client’s long hair in the salon. The reference screenshots of the live Gallery and About pages answer it: the photo shows a stylist using hairspray on a finished style, with no foils. So alt_original keeps version 1, the same as the gallery content file, and the Wix alt text of version 2 does not describe this photo. Nothing shown on the page depends on it. The one question left for the owner on this subject is which photo belongs in the top right box of the About page, see the ASK in content/about.json.
